{"id":1848193957,"question_id":3886,"lang":"cpp","lang_name":"C++","time":"7 months, 2 weeks","timestamp":1765011673,"status":10,"status_display":"Accepted","runtime":"62 ms","url":"/submissions/detail/1848193957/","is_pending":"Not Pending","title":"Count Number of Trapezoids I","memory":"195.6 MB","code":"class Solution {\npublic:\n    const int mod = 1e9+7;\n    int countTrapezoids(vector<vector<int>>& points) {\n        unordered_map<long long , long long>mp;\n\n        for(int i=0 ; i<points.size() ; i++)\n        {\n            mp[points[i][1]]++;\n        }\n\n        long long possible_combo = 0;\n        long long prev_lines = 0;\n        for(auto it : mp)\n        {\n            long long variations = (((it.second * (it.second - 1)) % mod) / 2) % mod;\n            possible_combo += (prev_lines * variations) % mod;\n            prev_lines += variations;\n        }\n        \n    return possible_combo % mod;\n    }\n};","compare_result":"","title_slug":"count-number-of-trapezoids-i","has_notes":false,"flag_type":1,"frontend_id":1233}
